acts.line: The morning's open — nothing on the calendar before the early-afternoon appointment.
The neurology appointment with Dr. Manning at HSS anchors the middle of the day in the city.
An early-evening flight out of LaGuardia lands you back in St. Pete, the Kenwood place waiting.
